strategy: Actively search for unusually strong current US deals as well as evergreen buying-guide opportunities.
Use official retailer sale and launch pages, product-launch news, rising search interest and public deal-community activity as discovery signals.
Treat public deal communities as demand signals only; do not automate self-promotion or affiliate-link posting into communities that prohibit it.
Score opportunities using the shared automation/deal_discovery_plan.json and prioritize candidates scoring 70 or above.
Create Deal Alert, Today's Best Deals, Price Drop Worth Buying, Launch Deal, Refurbished Deal, Seasonal Deal Hub and Viral Product Check content when the evidence supports it.

amazon.disclosure: As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.
strategy: major US product launches with immediate accessory demand
new iPhone, Samsung Galaxy and Google Pixel launches
new consoles, handhelds, tablets, smartwatches, headphones and cameras
cases, screen protectors, chargers, stands, cables, power banks, car mounts and storage accessories
new home and kitchen gadgets or appliances showing signs of breakout demand, strong launch interest or viral popularity
smart-home devices, robot cleaners, cordless cleaning gadgets, coffee and drinks gadgets, countertop cooking appliances, food-prep gadgets and other genuinely useful new household technology
verified deal opportunities and material price drops where current price evidence is available
replacement or add-on products buyers purchase immediately after a major product launch
fast-rising, viral or seasonal consumer products where US purchase intent is clear
high-intent comparison searches such as best case for, best charger for, best accessories for and what to buy with
rules: Prioritize US buyer intent and launch timing over generic search volume.
Use fresh web research each run and favor products that are actually relevant to the current US market.
For home and kitchen, favor genuinely new or fast-rising gadgets with credible signs of likely popularity rather than generic evergreen commodity products.
Check Worth Buying USA live posts, articles-us and queued US drafts before selecting a topic so the same subject is not repeated.
Create original, substantive buying guides with clear best-for recommendations, trade-offs and practical buying advice; avoid thin affiliate pages.
Every Amazon.com URL must be an Amazon US Special Link carrying tag=worthbuyingus-20.
Never use the UK tracking ID worthbuyin008-21 in a Worth Buying USA article.
Include the disclosure: As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.
Do not hard-code volatile prices unless verified on the same day.
Never claim a percentage saving solely from a crossed-out RRP or reference price; verify the deal independently where possible.
Do not invent discounts, review counts, ratings, stock claims or specifications.
Do not use Amazon product images or API-only product data unless permitted by Amazon's current rules and the required API/tool access is available.
Prefer evergreen launch-support articles that can remain useful after the first news spike, while still exploiting early accessory demand.

publishing.when_blogger_api_enabled_false: Emergency fallback only: if Blogger API authentication is unavailable, keep finished content queued and do not promote a non-live URL.
publishing.when_blogger_api_enabled_true: Primary route: publish approved/generated USA article JSON through the verified Blogger API, verify the required article image and live URL, then continue affiliate/social distribution.
publishing.x: Only promote after a live Worth Buying USA Blogger URL exists. Use the Worth Buying USA Buffer channel and put 'Affiliate' immediately before the destination URL; never use 'Ad/Affiliate'.
publishing.pinterest: For every live article, include pinterest_enabled=true plus a useful pinterest_title and pinterest_subtitle. Pinterest descriptions must use 'Affiliate' only and never 'Ad/Affiliate'.
publishing.social_order: Blogger live URL first, then Pinterest and X. Never promote a draft URL.

authority_strategy.objective: Build recurring organic traffic and affiliate revenue by concentrating content into commercial topic clusters and refreshing strong money pages rather than publishing unrelated one-offs.
authority_strategy.primary_conversion_goal: qualified affiliate clicks to tracked retailer links
authority_strategy.revenue_principle: Prioritize buyer intent, trustworthy product quality and useful retailer comparisons over vanity traffic.
